answers.rationale: For venue-centered conferences without materials or multiple suburban stops, the prior plans used rail and rideshares rather than adding a rental. With the hotel beside the venue and only one cross-town reception, rail plus rideshares is the lowest-friction plan.

The itinerary moves south from Sacramento through Modesto to Fresno. Returning from FAT follows the event path and avoids unnecessary Bay Area or Sacramento backtracking; prior routing decisions consistently favored endpoint airports when they materially reduced drive risk.

When a trip is a downtown conference with sessions and evening obligations concentrated in the official venue district, the history supports prioritizing proximity over suburban parking or breakfast advantages. Flying in without a car further favors the official downtown hotel.

The evening meetup and following-morning commitment are both downtown, and the traveler flies home after lunch. A downtown Hampton preserves location convenience while supplying breakfast, avoiding an unnecessary airport or suburban commute.
